table.name: account
table.purpose: Bank account table (Czech bank database): one row per account, with its opening date, branch district, and fee/statement frequency. Referenced by loans, cards, transactions, orders, and client dispositions.

account_id.name: account_id
account_id.description: Primary key; unique numeric identifier of the account.

date.name: account_opening_date
date.description: Date the account was opened (range 1993-01-01 to 1997-12-29).

district_id.name: district_id
district_id.description: Foreign key to district.district_id; the district (region) of the bank branch where the account was opened.

frequency.name: statement_issuance_frequency
frequency.description: Frequency of fee/statement issuance, in Czech: POPLATEK MESICNE = monthly, POPLATEK TYDNE = weekly, POPLATEK PO OBRATU = after each transaction.

table.name: card
table.purpose: Bank payment cards issued to account holders (via their disposition records). Each row is one issued card. This is the classic Czech bank (PKDD'99 Financial) dataset's card table.

card_id.name: card_id
card_id.description: Primary key; unique identifier of the issued card.

disp_id.name: disp_id
disp_id.description: Foreign key to disp.disp_id, identifying the disposition (person-account relationship) of the card holder; one-to-one, so each disposition has at most one card.

issued.name: issued
issued.description: Date the card was issued (stored as text, format YYYY-MM-DD).

type.name: type
type.description: Card product tier: 'classic' (standard card, 659), 'junior' (youth card, 145), 'gold' (premium card, 88).

table.name: client
table.purpose: Bank clients (persons): one row per client with birth date, gender, and home district. Linked to accounts via the disp (disposition) table. Part of a Czech bank dataset (districts like Jablonec n. Nisou).

birth_date.name: birth_date
birth_date.description: Client's date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD). Range 1911-1987 is consistent with birth dates of living clients.

client_id.name: client_id
client_id.description: Primary key; unique client identifier. Referenced one-to-one by disp.client_id (each client has one disposition/account link in this data).

district_id.name: district_id
district_id.description: Foreign key to district.district_id; the client's district (region) of residence, 1-77 Czech districts.

table.name: disp
table.purpose: Disposition table linking clients to bank accounts; each row records a client's relationship (owner or authorized user/dispoment) to one account. One client per account is the OWNER; additional clients are DISPONENT (authorized users).

account_id.name: account_id
account_id.description: Identifier of the bank account this disposition refers to; references account.account_id (many dispositions per account).

client_id.name: client_id
client_id.description: Identifier of the client attached to the account; references client.client_id. Unique in this table (each client appears in exactly one disposition).

disp_id.name: disp_id
disp_id.description: Primary key of the disposition record; also referenced by card.disp_id, i.e. a payment card is issued through a disposition.

type.name: type
type.description: Type of client relationship to the account: OWNER (account holder, 4500 rows, one per account) or DISPONENT (authorized user / disponent, 869 rows).

table.name: district
table.purpose: Demographic and socioeconomic statistics for the 77 districts of the Czech Republic (PKDD'99 Financial dataset). One row per district; referenced by clients and accounts via district_id.

A11.name: average_salary
A11.description: Average monthly salary in the district (CZK; values ~8,100-12,500).

A14.name: entrepreneurs_per_1000
A14.description: Number of registered entrepreneurs per 1,000 inhabitants (values 81-167).

A15.name: committed_crimes_1995
A15.description: Number of committed crimes in 1995 (counts; Prague outlier ~85,677).

A16.name: committed_crimes_1996
A16.description: Number of committed crimes in 1996 (counts; Prague outlier ~99,107).

A2.name: district_name
A2.description: Name of the district (e.g. Benesov, Brno - mesto, Jablonec n. Nisou).

A3.name: region
A3.description: Region of the Czech Republic the district belongs to (8 values: Prague, central/north/south/east Bohemia, north/south Moravia).

A4.name: population
A4.description: Total number of inhabitants of the district (stored as text; Prague ~1.2M).

A5.name: municipalities_under_500
A5.description: Number of municipalities with fewer than 500 inhabitants (stored as text).

A6.name: municipalities_500_1999
A6.description: Number of municipalities with 500-1,999 inhabitants (stored as text).

A7.name: municipalities_2000_9999
A7.description: Number of municipalities with 2,000-9,999 inhabitants (stored as text).

A8.name: municipalities_over_10000
A8.description: Number of municipalities with 10,000 or more inhabitants (stored as text).

A9.name: num_cities
A9.description: Number of cities in the district (1-11).

district_id.name: district_id
district_id.description: Primary key; district identifier 1-77. Referenced by client.district_id and account.district_id.

table.name: loan
table.purpose: One row per loan granted to a bank account; records loan amount, date, term, monthly payment, and repayment status. Part of a classic bank-account schema (accounts, clients, cards, orders, transactions).

account_id.name: account_id
account_id.description: Identifier of the account that took out the loan; references account.account_id (one-to-one here, i.e. at most one loan per account in this table).

amount.name: amount
amount.description: Principal amount of the loan, in the account currency (values 4,980 to 590,820, median ~116,928).

date.name: date
date.description: Date the loan was granted (1993-07-05 to 1998-12-08).

duration.name: duration
duration.description: Loan term in months; only values 12, 24, 36, 48, 60 occur.

payments.name: payments
payments.description: Monthly installment payment for the loan (304 to 9,910). Consistent with amount/duration, e.g. 76080/12 = 6340.

status.name: status
status.description: Loan repayment status code with four values A, B, C, D. Most plausible reading (standard for this schema): A = contract finished, loan paid; B = contract finished, loan not paid; C = contract running, payments OK; D = contract running, client in debt. Exact mapping is not provable from the data alone.

table.name: order
table.purpose: Permanent/standing payment orders of bank accounts: recurring transfers from an account to an external bank account, with amount, destination bank code, and payment type. (PKDD'99-style bank data.)

account_id.name: account_id
account_id.description: Owning account; references account.account_id (many orders per account).

account_to.name: account_to
account_to.description: Destination account number at the external bank receiving the payment.

amount.name: amount
amount.description: Payment amount per occurrence, in the account currency (values 1–14882, median ~2596).

bank_to.name: bank_to
bank_to.description: Code of the destination bank (13 anonymized two-letter codes).

k_symbol.name: k_symbol
k_symbol.description: Payment type/character: SIPO (household/utility payment), UVER (loan repayment), POJISTNE (insurance premium), LEASING (leasing payment), empty = unspecified/other.

order_id.name: order_id
order_id.description: Primary key; unique identifier of the standing order.

table.name: trans
table.purpose: Bank account transaction records (Czech Berka-style financial dataset). Each row is one transaction on an account: its date, type, operation, amount, resulting balance, and for bank transfers the counterparty bank and account number. Linked to account via account_id.

account.name: counterparty_account_number
account.description: Account number of the counterparty for bank transfers (operation PREVOD NA UCET / PREVOD Z UCTU). Null (72%) for cash withdrawals/deposits. Values are large opaque account numbers; '0' (21881 rows) likely means no/unknown counterparty account. Not a join key to the account table in this database.

account_id.name: account_id
account_id.description: ID of the account the transaction belongs to; references account.account_id (many transactions per account).

amount.name: amount
amount.description: Transaction amount in the account's currency (Czech crowns, whole units). Min 0, max 87,400; median 2,100. The very frequent value 15 likely a recurring small fee/payment.

balance.name: balance_after_transaction
balance.description: Account balance in crowns after the transaction. Can be negative (overdraft, min -41,126), max 209,637.

bank.name: counterparty_bank_code
bank.description: Two-letter code of the counterparty bank for transfers (PREVOD operations); null for cash operations. 13 anonymized bank codes (QR, AB, ST, ...).

k_symbol.name: transaction_characterization
k_symbol.description: Czech code describing the transaction's purpose: UROK = interest credited, SLUZBY = payment for services/statement, SIPO = household (utility) payment, DUCHOD = old-age pension, UVER = loan payment, POJISTNE = insurance payment, SANKC. UROK = sanction interest. Blank/null when not applicable.

operation.name: operation
operation.description: Czech operation mode: VYBER = cash withdrawal, VYBER KARTOU = card withdrawal, VKLAD = cash deposit, PREVOD NA UCET = transfer to another account, PREVOD Z UCTU = transfer from another account. Null (17%) likely for interest credit rows.

type.name: transaction_type
type.description: Czech transaction type: PRIJEM = credit (income), VYDAJ = debit (expense), VYBER = withdrawal (recorded separately from VYDAJ).
